<select id="selectDeviceForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.asset.dal.dataobject.device.DeviceDO">
        SELECT id,
               sn,
               project_id,
               project_assignment_version,
               customer_id,
               customer_assignment_version,
               tenant_id
        FROM ast_device
        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND id = #{query.deviceId}
          AND deleted = b'0'
        FOR UPDATE
    </select>

<select id="selectCurrentProject" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.asset.dal.dataobject.assignment.DeviceProjectRelationshipDO">
        SELECT id,
               device_sn,
               project_id,
               relationship_type,
               effective_from,
               effective_to,
               assignment_version,
               reason,
               operation_id,
               source_system,
               source_key,
               source_version,
               version,
               tenant_id
        FROM ast_device_project_relationship
        WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
          AND device_sn = (
              SELECT sn
              FROM ast_device
              WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId}
                AND id = #{query.deviceId}
                AND deleted = b'0'
          )
          AND relationship_type = 'DIRECT'
          AND effective_to IS NULL
          AND deleted = b'0'
        LIMIT 1
    </select>

<update id="closeCurrentProject">
        UPDATE ast_device_project_relationship r
        JOIN ast_device d
          ON d.tenant_id = r.tenant_id
         AND d.sn = r.device_sn
        SET r.effective_to = #{effectiveTo},
            r.assignment_version = #{assignmentVersion}
        WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
          AND d.id = #{deviceId}
          AND r.relationship_type = 'DIRECT'
          AND r.effective_to IS NULL
          AND r.deleted = b'0'
    </update>

<insert id="insertProjectRelationship" useGeneratedKeys="true" keyProperty="id">
        INSERT INTO ast_device_project_relationship (
            device_sn,
            project_id,
            relationship_type,
            effective_from,
            effective_to,
            assignment_version,
            reason,
            operation_id,
            source_system,
            source_key,
            source_version,
            version,
            tenant_id
        ) VALUES (
            #{deviceSn},
            #{projectId},
            #{relationshipType},
            #{effectiveFrom},
            #{effectiveTo},
            #{assignmentVersion},
            #{reason},
            #{operationId},
            #{sourceSystem},
            #{sourceKey},
            #{sourceVersion},
            #{version},
            #{tenantId}
        )
    </insert>

<update id="updateDeviceProjectIfMatch">
        UPDATE ast_device
        SET project_id = #{update.projectId},
            project_assignment_version = #{update.newAssignmentVersion}
        WHERE tenant_id = #{update.tenantId}
          AND id = #{update.deviceId}
          AND project_assignment_version = #{update.expectedAssignmentVersion}
          AND deleted = b'0'
    </update>

<select id="selectBatchForUpdate" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.asset.dal.dataobject.device.DeviceDO">
    SELECT id,tenant_id,project_id,contract_no,company_id,company_name,department_id,department_code,department_name,organization_source,organization_updated_at
    <include refid="selection" /> FOR UPDATE
  </select>

<select id="selectStoredOrganizations" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.asset.dal.dataobject.device.DeviceDO">
    SELECT id,company_id,company_name,department_id,department_code,department_name,organization_source
    <include refid="selection" />
  </select>

<update id="updateOrganizationBatch">
    UPDATE ast_device SET company_id=#{query.companyId},company_name=#{query.companyName},
      department_id=#{query.departmentId},department_code=#{query.departmentCode},department_name=#{query.departmentName},
      organization_source=#{query.source},organization_updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
    WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=0
      AND id IN <foreach collection="deviceIds" item="id" open="(" close=")" separator=",">#{id}</foreach>
  </update>

<update id="updateOrganizationRows">
    <choose>
      <when test="rows != null and !rows.isEmpty()">
        UPDATE ast_device SET
          company_id=CASE id
            <foreach collection="rows" item="row">WHEN #{row.deviceId} THEN #{row.companyId}</foreach>
            ELSE company_id END,
          company_name=CASE id
            <foreach collection="rows" item="row">WHEN #{row.deviceId} THEN #{row.companyName}</foreach>
            ELSE company_name END,
          department_id=CASE id
            <foreach collection="rows" item="row">WHEN #{row.deviceId} THEN #{row.departmentId}</foreach>
            ELSE department_id END,
          department_code=CASE id
            <foreach collection="rows" item="row">WHEN #{row.deviceId} THEN #{row.departmentCode}</foreach>
            ELSE department_code END,
          department_name=CASE id
            <foreach collection="rows" item="row">WHEN #{row.deviceId} THEN #{row.departmentName}</foreach>
            ELSE department_name END,
          organization_source=CASE id
            <foreach collection="rows" item="row">WHEN #{row.deviceId} THEN #{row.source}</foreach>
            ELSE organization_source END,
          organization_updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
        WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
          AND id IN <foreach collection="rows" item="row" open="(" close=")" separator=",">#{row.deviceId}</foreach>
      </when>
      <otherwise>
        UPDATE ast_device SET id=id WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND 1=0
      </otherwise>
    </choose>
  </update>

               rma_related_sn,

               order_line_id,
               source_payload,
               product_code,
               secondary_sn,
               secondary_item,
               internal_serial_no,
               is_rma,
               profit_center,
               sole_agent_suffix,
               sync_time,
               uuid,
               shipment_time,
               package_no,
               contract_no,
               event_type,
               warranty_start_date,
               warranty_months,
               rma_no,
               related_device_sn,
               source_system,
               source_key,
               source_version,
               source_updated_at,
               synced_at,
               sync_status,
               version,
               creator,
